title: Android sale attribution and staff reconciliation validation
scope: Experimental single-process Android checkout on Regtest: manual-sale Ledger v9 attribution, strict Ledger v8 migration, staff receipt reconciliation, source/model validation, two-ABI package build, and disposable API 35 acceptance workflow.

checks.name: complete checkout JVM model suite
checks.result: passed with -Werror and jvm-target 1.8; includes sale v8-to-v9 migration, strict attribution decode, staff receipt reconciliation, stable cross-file reads, active-owner exclusion, legacy audit migration, rollback mismatch, replay, and concurrent prepare coverage

checks.name: experimental checkout Android package
checks.result: passed; feature-verified native libraries packaged for arm64-v8a and x86_64, Kotlin compiled, APK dexed, aligned, test-signed, and signature-verified

checks.name: disposable API 35 Android acceptance
checks.result: passed full non-expiry suite, including exactly one unpaid attributed-path sale across restart, staff policy and role access, lifecycle locks, report-picker process death, manager recovery, fail-closed authority loss, prior-data enrollment block, and pairing-picker process death

open_gates: Tender, refund, provider-observation, catalog, and inventory mutations remain unattributed compatibility paths.
Ledger same-file atomicity is not multi-instance CAS, tamper evidence, or rollback protection.
Staff live-owner exclusion assumes OpenBMT's single Android process; multiprocess access is unsupported.
Receipt anchors cannot detect coordinated rollback or a rollback that erases the only receipt before a terminal audit row survives.
Uncertain ledger and cross-file crash handling is source/JVM fault-injection covered, not emulator fault-injected or physical-device validated.
Pre-v2 ambiguous staff prepares remain blocked, and bounded histories need an archival/rotation design.
The optional five-minute expiry probe, production card hardware/approval, mainnet, integrated Lightning tender, merchant shifts, and real funds were not tested.
claim_boundary: The evidence supports a single-process Regtest Android manual-sale attribution path and conservative staff reconciliation. Canonical statuses in the 502-capability register remain unchanged.
